//! Run this helper against 9e51100 (store v7 on turso =0.9.0-pre.1), before
//! the turso 0.9.0-pre.5 pin. See fixtures/README.md. It refuses to
//! overwrite a fixture.
mod support;

use strata_store::NewProposal;
use strata_types::{CommitOid, DepsSetId, MarkByKind, MarkState};
use support::world::*;

#[test]
#[ignore = "fixture generator: run only against the pinned pre.1 source"]
fn generate_v7_fixture() {
    let env = support::env();
    let s = env.open();
    world(&env, &s);
    let head = CommitOid::try_from("2".repeat(40)).unwrap();
    s.record_proposal(&NewProposal {
        repo: repo(), origin: None, from: gen1().deps,
        from_inputs: "a".repeat(64), from_head: None, to: DepsSetId::try_from("b".repeat(64)).unwrap(),
        to_inputs: "b".repeat(64), tree: Some(gen1().tree), head: Some(head),
    }, None, t(20)).unwrap();
    s.set_mark(&sid(), MarkState::Done, Some("written by turso pre.1"), MarkByKind::Cli, t(21)).unwrap();
    s.close().unwrap();
    let bytes = std::fs::read(env.db()).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(u32::from_be_bytes(bytes[60..64].try_into().unwrap()), 7);
    let out = std::path::Path::new(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR")).join("tests/fixtures/store-v7-turso-pre1.db");
    use std::io::Write;
    std::fs::OpenOptions::new().write(true).create_new(true).open(out).unwrap().write_all(&bytes).unwrap();
}
